title: Notification settings
intro: Choose whether you get the daily summary. Anything that needs your decision is always sent at once.

digest.title: Daily summary
digest.label: Send me the daily summary
digest.hint: A summary of the tasks waiting for you, overdue work and budgets running low in your scope, sent on working-day mornings, only when there is something to report.
digest.turnedOff: The daily summary is off. Approval tasks and overdue work still reach you at once.

always.title: Always sent at once, cannot be turned off
always.intro: These need you to act, so they are always sent at once and nothing is left waiting.
always.reminders: Reminders of tasks nearly due and overdue tasks
always.escalations: Tasks passed on to you to decide as well

channel.title: Where they arrive
channel.text: Work notices such as approval tasks, task reminders, the results of your requests and the daily summary go by LINE when you have linked your LINE account and your organization uses LINE. When it is not linked, your organization has LINE off or LINE cannot deliver, they go by e-mail instead. Account security notices always go by e-mail, never by LINE. Everything is also in the notification bell on the web.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again and repeat this.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this. Ask your organization administrator.
errors.BUSY: Something else of yours is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it keeps failing, give this reference to the BCS team.
errors.FAILED: It was not saved; the previous setting still applies. Try again.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, so it is not certain the change was saved. Try again, or reload the page to see the setting in effect.

appPush.title: Notifications in the BCS Go app
appPush.label: Notify me in the app
appPush.hint: When on, approval tasks and work notices pop up on your registered phones instead of LINE. If the app cannot be reached they go by LINE, then e-mail, as before. The lock screen shows the document number only, never an amount or a name
appPush.hintBrowser: Turn it on in the BCS Go app on your phone: open the app, come to this page and turn the switch on. The phone asks to allow notifications and is registered
appPush.turnedOn: Notifications in the app are on, and this phone is registered
appPush.turnedOff: Notifications in the app are off. Work notices go by LINE, then e-mail, as before
appPush.moduleOff: Your organization has not turned the BCS Go app on. Contact your organization administrator
appPush.deviceEnded: The device is ended and gets no more notifications

token.NOT_IN_APP: This can be turned on in the BCS Go app only
token.DENIED: The phone does not allow BCS Go to notify you. Allow the app's notifications in the phone's settings, then try again
token.UNAVAILABLE: The phone could not be registered. Check the connection and try again

devices.none: No phone is registered for notifications in the app yet
